provenance.metadata_transformation: Original relative paths/file SHA256 strings are preserved verbatim. Added provenance/comparison metadata is serialized as UTF-8 JSON with LF and indentation. Original JSON byte hashes are recorded separately; no source-file hash is replaced by a normalized hash.

comparison.exact_reproduction: For the 92 differing paths only, read the frozen Git blob, verify its SHA256 equals the Mac entry, and replace every LF byte (0a) with CRLF (0d0a). These inputs contain no CR bytes. Keep the remaining 43 blobs unchanged. All 135 output hashes reproduce the original Windows inventory fingerprint.
comparison.derived_fingerprint_status: Supplementary audit calculation after CRLF-to-LF normalization on both reconstructed inventories; not an original validation fingerprint and not a replacement for either reported fingerprint.
comparison.current_local_byte_check_role: Corroboration only. No current-checkout inventory was used as original evidence.
